name: flywise-ai
description: FlyWise AI - intelligent flight discovery and booking platform (academic minor project)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n user-api,admin-api,user-web,admin-web,ai -c blue,magenta,cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @flywise/user-backend" "npm run dev -w @flywise/admin-backend" "npm run dev -w @flywise/user-frontend" "npm run dev -w @flywise/admin-frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -n user-api,admin-api,user-web,admin-web -c blue,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @flywise/user-backend" "npm run dev -w @flywise/admin-backend" "npm run dev -w @flywise/user-frontend" "npm run dev -w @flywise/admin-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @flywise/user-frontend && npm run build -w @flywise/admin-frontend
